School of Electrical & Electronic Engineering (EEE) is seeking a research engineer (RE) passionate about spearheading the discovery of new physics in emerging materials, especially pertaining to the development of compact, high-brightness X-ray sources. In particular, the RE will explore techniques to miniaturize particle accelerators in free-electron-driven X-ray sources. Our objective is to realize features currently available only in large scale X-ray facilities in a table-top setup. Compact, high quality X-ray sources have potential applications in industrial inspection, medical imaging and treatment, forensics, security inspection, and would also have a transformative impact on fundamental science (where X-rays have been responsible for >25 Nobel Prizes in Physics, Chemistry and Physiology/Medicine). Our research takes place at the boundary of quantum optics, particle waveshaping and nanomaterials. Read more about our work at our group website .

Key Responsibilities:

  • Discover new phenomena and develop new applications pertaining to the miniaturization of particle accelerators and X-ray sources

ABOUT THE POSITION

We are looking for a hands-on Machine Learning Engineer to develop an enterprise AI agent platform, with a strong backend focus. You will build agent execution and orchestration capabilities, integrate enterprise systems, and deliver secure, reliable features from backend services to frontend interfaces

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Security and reliability
    • Protect credentials, preserve user access boundaries across systems, and apply appropriate execution isolation and audit logging.
    • Improve concurrency control, retries, idempotency, cancellation, and recovery; trace failures across model calls, tools, and workers.
  • Quality and collaboration
    • Maintain automated and integration tests, CI/CD, and agent evaluations covering task success, output quality, latency, and cost.
    • Work with product, design, IT, SRE, and business system owners; contribute code reviews, documentation, and technical guidance.

Job description

About the Role We are looking for a Gemini Enterprise Agent Engineer to lead the design, development, and governance of enterprise AI agents built on Gemini Enterprise and Gemini models. This role owns the full lifecycle of agent development — from architecture and grounding to deployment, evaluation, and ongoing governance — ensuring agents are accurate, safe, compliant, and trusted enough to run in production across the business. You'll be the go-to expert for building agents on Gemini Enterprise (agent design, orchestration, grounding, connectors) and for establishing the governance frameworks — access control, evaluation, auditing, and responsible-AI guardrails — that keep those agents reliable at scale. Underlying cloud infrastructure runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), so working familiarity with GCP is helpful for collaborating with the platform team Key Responsibilities Gemini Enterprise Agent Development Design, build, and own multi-agent solutions on Gemini Enterprise (formerly Agentspace) — agent architecture, orchestration, task/tool design, and multi-turn conversation flows. Configure grounding, enterprise search, and data connectors so agents retrieve accurate, up-to-date, and properly-scoped information. Integrate Gemini models (via the Gemini API and/or Vertex AI) into agents and downstream applications, tuning prompts, context strategies, and tool/function calling for reliability. AI Governance & Responsible Agent Operations Define and implement governance frameworks for Gemini Enterprise agents: access control, data permissions, usage policies, and approval workflows for new agents going into production. Establish monitoring, logging, and audit trails for agent behavior, including token usage, response quality, and policy violations. Partner with security, legal, and compliance stakeholders to ensure agents meet data privacy, residency, and responsible-AI requirements. Create and maintain documentation, review checklists, and lifecycle standards (build → evaluate → approve → monitor → retire) for enterprise agents. Track Gemini model and Gemini Enterprise feature releases and assess their impact on existing agents and governance policies. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Automation Work closely with data science, AI engineering, security, and business teams to translate use cases into governed, production-ready agents. Automate agent configuration, evaluation, and deployment workflows using Python and APIs/SDKs for Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI. jobs.api_description_text:
We are hiring a senior engineer to own the agent systems behind Nas.com. Our agents watch ad accounts, social channels, and the market around the clock, build a live memory of each business, and act on what they find once a human says yes. Your job is to make them reliable, fast, cheap to run, and safe to trust.


About Nas.com


Nas.com builds AI that does the work of growing a business, not just answers questions about it.


  • Agents (nas.com/agents) is our AI agent platform for marketing teams. It connects ads, social, CRM, content, analytics, and transaction data into one marketing brain for each company. Agents then work on it 24/7: watching ad accounts and social channels, improving ad performance, monitoring reputation and competitors, and flagging what needs a human decision.
  • Solopreneur (nas.com/solopreneur) is our platform for solo entrepreneurs. With help from AI agents, they can set up a store, generate marketing materials, connect to ad platforms for traffic, and collect payments worldwide, all in minutes.


We have raised US$40 million, most recently in a round led by Khosla Ventures and 500 Global. We are based in Singapore and build for customers worldwide.


The Role


This is a hands-on role, and you are responsible for delivery. Our agents run in production for paying businesses, with real money on the line, and the results are yours to own. You will decide how our agents are designed and built, own the runtime that keeps them accurate, fast, and efficient, and use your own judgment to make the AI smarter with every release. You will also own the backend integrations that bring customer data into the platform. Agent systems come first, but you will reach across the stack when the problem needs it.


What You'll Do


  • Build the core of our agents. Agent loops, tool execution, context and memory, and workflows that survive failures. Add multi-agent coordination only where it helps.
  • Make agents safe to act. Design the permissions, guardrails, and approval flows for agents that spend real money and write to real systems.
  • Make quality measurable. Build evals from real workflows and real failures. Measure accuracy, tool use, and end-to-end task success, and catch regressions before release.
  • Cut cost and latency without losing quality. Test model routing, retrieval, context, caching, and concurrency against real workloads. Track cost per successful task and tail latency.
  • Set the technical bar. Define how we structure agents, evals, and observability. Lead design reviews and help the team make better calls.
  • Own delivery end to end. From design to a solution that is shipped and running inside a customer's business. When the same pain shows up twice, fix the system, not the symptom.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of software engineering, with strong backend and system-design fundamentals.
  • You have shipped and operated LLM agents for real users, and you own the decisions and failures that came with them.
  • You know what agent frameworks do under the hood. You have built or extended the orchestration core yourself: state, tool execution, retries, recovery.
  • You have built agent evals and used them to improve accuracy or task success.
  • You have cut agent latency or cost in production and can show how you measured it.
  • You take an ambiguous problem, give it structure, and drive it to a working outcome.


Bonus Points


  • Time at both a large tech company and an early-stage startup.
  • Multiple agents coordinating in production, including handoffs, shared state, failure propagation.
  • Large-scale data ingestion, or integrations with ads, social, CRM, analytics, or payment platforms.
  • Open-source work, writing, or talks on agent systems. Experience with MCP. Fine-tuning or distilling smaller models to cut cost.


Our Stack


Python and TypeScript. LangChain and LangSmith for orchestration and tracing. MongoDB and ClickHouse for data. AWS for infrastructure. Deep integrations with Google/Meta Ads and other marketing platforms. You do not need to know all of it. You need to be able to pick it up fast.


Why Join Us


You will own the product and the technology behind it, and you will see the results in our customers' businesses. This is not a chatbot bolted onto an existing product. Agents, context, tools, data, and integrations are the core architecture, and the architecture you design becomes the platform's.


We grew out of content creation, so we move fast, experiment a lot, and care about what we make. We are backed by top Silicon Valley investors, serve customers around the world, and build from Singapore. Small senior team, real autonomy, no layers between you and the decision. If you want to build something ambitious with people who are all in, this is the place.


We care about output, not hours. Nobody tracks when you arrive or leave. We do expect real ownership: time spent learning, and what you learn brought back to the team. In return you get flexibility and the support to do your best work. Work always costs you time. We want that time to come back to you as something you are proud of.


What We Offer

  • Competitive package with stock options.
  • Hybrid work in Singapore. Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation support.
  • Self-care and mental-health funds.
  • Company lunches and a monthly SGD 250 Grab allowance.
  • Yearly company retreats.


If you want to build AI that runs real businesses, and see the results, we would love to hear from you.

About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

As a Software Engineer Intern, Agent, you'll work directly on production AI agents for Sierra's customers. You'll gain hands-on experience contributing to the design and development of AI agents, shipping features, and learning from real-world use cases at scale. If you're hungry to shape and learn from the most important technological wave in history, come build at Sierra.

What you'll bring

  • Pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

  • A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship

  • Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences

Even better

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

  • Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

  • Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

Intern qualifications

  • The intern program is open to students graduating December 2027 - June 2028

  • Note: The full benefits listed below are available only to full-time employees. Interns are eligible for a monthly stipend for health insurance, daily lunch, and, of course, free alphorn lessons.

Our values

  • Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

  • Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

  • Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

  • Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at accommodations@sierra.ai. Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We are hiring a hands-on security engineer to build and security-test a realistic clinical agentic AI system.

Build the clinical agent

Threat model and red-team

Findings and mitigation

jobs.api_description_text:
We’re building a next-generation digital banking platform with AI at its core, deployed at a regulated bank and serving both employees and real customers.

You will be the hands-on engineer building these systems. Working within a nimble, full-ownership squad, you will build agentic AI products and the platform they run on, turning solution designs into working, production-grade systems that support customer growth and operational efficiency.

We’re looking for a strong backend engineer who has started building with AI, and wants to go deeper.

Job Responsibilities
What You’ll Build
● Multi-agent workflows: Specialist AI agents that work together on complex tasks, such as analysing information from many sources and assembling the evidence into one case.
● Customer AI agents: AI agents that help customers directly, answering questions and completing tasks.
● Agentic banking products: AI powered product that works across customer onboarding, growth and back-office operations.

What You’ll Do
● Own what you build end to end: technical design, build, testing, deployment and production support
● Design agentic AI workflows, including orchestration, state and memory, and the error handling that keeps them reliable
● Build and maintain the Java and Spring Boot services, APIs and data/event pipelines that connect our AI to core banking, KYC platforms and customer systems
● Keep business logic in version-controlled, tested services so agent behaviour is auditable
● Build evaluation suites and take AI products from pilot to full scale
● Build in guardrails and controls, including access controls, data masking, human-in-the-loop checks and fallbacks, so everything meets the bank’s security, resilience, audit and regulatory requirements and MAS’s Guidelines on AI Risk Management
● Monitor AI quality, latency and cost in production, and keep improving them
● Explore the latest AI models, tools and platforms, run proofs of concept, and assess whether they are feasible for the bank, including their value, cost, security and regulatory fit
● Work closely with operations, compliance and other business teams to turn their day-to-day needs into product features
  • Build reusable components and share them with other squads and our parent group’s engineers
  • Min 5 years of backend software development, with strong production experience in Java and Spring Boot

● Solid understanding of distributed systems and microservices, with experience in public cloud and Kubernetes
● Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic AI, such as tool calling, agent frameworks or RAG. Production experience is a strong plus, and serious side projects count
● An understanding of how to test and evaluate non-deterministic AI systems
● Clear communication with non-engineers, including operations and compliance teams
● Proficiency in English and Mandarin, as you’ll work with parent-group teams and Chinese-language documents

The Smart Manufacturing and AI team at Micron Technology is looking for an ambitious engineer (Member of Technical Staff | MTS) to deliver industry-winning Agentic AI solutions that power Micron’s dominance in the highly competitive memory solutions market. This role sits at the intersection of applied Agentic AI engineering and production systems work: you will architect autonomous AI Agents and the agentic and data pipelines that power them, build robust CI/CD deployment paths to Kubernetes and containers, and push the limits of agent performance profiling and evaluation to turn massive data and compute into measurable manufacturing impact. Qualified applicants will have experience across data/cloud technologies and systems engineering, with extensive practice modeling data, querying, and deploying scalable pipelines to execute AI agents. You will collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers and expert users to build and deploy scalable Agentic AI solutions that drive value and insight from Micron’s manufacturing processes and systems.

If you enjoy solving hard problems at scale, thrive on turning speculative research into production-grade systems, and want to see your work drive silicon to market, this is the team for you.

Responsibilities include, but not limited to:

  • Design and develop autonomous AI Agents capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool execution to automate complex manufacturing workflows.

  • Implement Agentic frameworks to orchestrate LLM interactions with internal APIs, databases, and software tools.

  • Build and maintain agent evaluation harnesses to benchmark agent accuracy, reliability, and task success across complex, multi-step workflows.

  • Analyze and profile agent and inference workloads (e.g., tool-calling latency, multi-agent orchestration) to identify and resolve bottlenecks in compute and latency, using agent observability and profiling tools (e.g., PyTorch Profiler, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry).

  • Implement interoperable multi-agent systems using the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including MCP tools, plugins, and skills.

  • Create/maintain CI/CD pipelines for deploying AI Agents to Kubernetes and containerized environments in the cloud.

  • Design and implement security controls for autonomous AI Agents, including sandboxing, access control, and mitigation of prompt-injection and tool-misuse risks.

  • Mentor engineers on agentic system design paradigms and optimization techniques.

Education Qualifications:

Technical Degree required (Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field). Ph.D. is a plus.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience optimizing inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) for autonomous AI Agent and LLM workloads.

  • Experience developing GenAI applications and AI Agents using one or more frameworks. Microsoft Agent Framework or Google Agent Development Kit preferred.

  • Proficiency with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, function calling/tool use, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning.

  • Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and vector search.

  • Experience building and operating end-to-end systems that automate the testing, evaluation, and deployment of autonomous AI Agents.

  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, plugins, and skills, and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol for building interoperable multi-agent systems.

  • Understanding of AI Agent security practices, including sandboxing, access control, and mitigating prompt-injection and tool-misuse risks.

  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, etc).

  • Strong scripting and programming skills, with software development skills and a desire to work in a cloud environment.

  • 8+ years of relevant industry experience, spanning large-scale data/ML pipelines and/or production Agentic AI systems.

  • Outstanding analytical thinking, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.

  • Ability to prioritize and meet critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized applications, including deployment and scaling of AI Agent workloads.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing and coordinating Multi-Agent Systems, including collaboration between specialized agents.

  • Experience designing and operating agent swarms for distributed, parallelized task execution.

  • Experience with agent profiling and evaluation tooling to identify performance regressions and bottlenecks across agent pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Rust.

  • Demonstrated ability to study and transform data science prototypes into production solutions.

  • Knowledge of computer vision and/or signal processing, including techniques for classification and feature extraction.

jobs.api_description_text:
Company Description

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

Job Description

Pre-Sales Support and Solution Design

  • Assist in solution and bid reviews to ensure completeness, feasibility, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Lead initial solution design, project planning, and costing for client proposals.
  • Undertake complex requirements gathering, client workshops, and presentations.
  • Design sophisticated security solutions integrating application, network, cloud ICT, and OT components.
  • Provide expertise and guidance in strategic and mega tenders as the Solution Manager and single point of contact for cybersecurity solutions.

Client Engagement and Consulting

  • Build and maintain professional relationships with clients through regular communication, on-site meetings, and executive briefings.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to help clients integrate cybersecurity capabilities into their environments.
  • Engage with C-level executives to identify and address domain-specific cybersecurity needs.
  • Deliver proactive technical guidance to clients to drive cybersecurity operational excellence.
  • Influence clients' cybersecurity postures by contributing to in-flight projects and leading innovation initiatives.

Expertise Development and Industry Awareness

  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity technologies, regulatory frameworks, and industry trends.
  • Support ongoing client requirements related to regulatory compliance (e.g., IM8, AIAS, CSA Security by Design, MAS TRM).
  • Participate in trade shows and conferences as a senior technical resource
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) in cyber security solutions and technologies.

Securing AI systems

  • Understand enterprise AI architectures—including LLMs, RAG, vector databases, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and MCP integrations—and assess risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, insecure outputs, excessive agency, tool misuse, retrieval poisoning, and supply chain compromise.
  • Design AI security controls spanning gateways, runtime protection, model scanning, posture management, and monitoring; enforce least privilege across agent identities, tools, and downstream systems through scoped authorisation, tool allowlists, sandboxing, human approvals, audit trails, and emergency shutdown mechanisms.
Qualifications
  • Extensive experience (5+ years) as a Security Presales Consultant
  • Due to project sensitivity, we can only consider Singapore Citizen
  • Presales experience in designing and architecting comprehensive cybersecurity solutions that involve at least two or more cybersecurity domains, such as:
    • Application Security
    • Database Security
    • Regulatory Compliance
    • Identity and Access Management
    • Privileged Access Management
    • Cloud Security
    • Endpoint Security
    • Incident Response and Managed Security Services
    • Infrastructure and Network Security
    • DevSecOps
    • Zero Trust Security
  • Experience in designing and architecting comprehensive cybersecurity solutions, including Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Data Access Management (DAM), Secure Service Edge (SSE), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Endpoint Security, and Network Security, ensuring robust protection against evolving threats.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based solutions (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and best practices for security, resilience, and recovery.
  • Solid understanding of security protocols, cryptography, PKI, and authentication/authorization frameworks.
  • Experience implementing SIEM/SOAR tools and conducting database configurations and basic queries.
  • Ability to translate complex security solutions into business value propositions
  • Knowledge of WAN, IoT/Video, Kubernetes, and containerized applications is advantageous.
  • Previous experience with government tenders and Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance (GRC).
  • Experience working with security practitioners, network, application, and database operations personnel.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CISA, CISM, CISSP, GCIA) are highly desirable.
  • Experience working in client-serving/project-based models
Additional Information

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

jobs.api_description_text:
About the Team

Salesforce AI Research Labs is at the forefront of Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Deep Learning. Our team launched Einstein GPT — the world's first Generative AI for CRM — delivering AI-created content across every sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT interaction at hyper-scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai. Today, we continue to advance the frontier of enterprise AI through innovations in reasoning engines, agent architectures, and autonomous AI systems, including the Atlas Reasoning Engine, that are redefining how enterprises reason, plan, and act.

What makes our team unique is our ability to take ideas from research to real-world impact at scale. We publish at the world's top AI conferences, open source influential research, collaborate with leading academic institutions, and work closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. Our innovations continue to shape the future of Salesforce products and the broader enterprise AI ecosystem. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

Role Overview

  • We are looking for entrepreneurial Research Scientists who want to build, ship, and scale the next generation of Enterprise AI.

  • This is not a traditional research role. You will work like a founder within Salesforce — identifying high-impact research directions, prototyping cutting-edge AI capabilities, validating ideas directly with customers, and turning the strongest concepts into production-ready solutions.

  • You will have the freedom to propose and incubate new research ideas, access Salesforce’s global customer and product ecosystem, and quickly validate new innovations with external and internal customers and stakeholders.

  • We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, move with urgency, and care as much about customer adoption as technical innovation. If you want the pace and ownership of a startup, combined with the reach and resources of Salesforce, this role offers a unique opportunity to build Enterprise AI with global impact

Responsibilities

  • Own and pursue ambitious, long-term research goals

  • Develop solutions for real-world, large-scale problems

  • Lead teams (as needed) to deliver on complex pure and applied research projects

We are looking for a Senior Researcher to conduct early-stage Data Science and AI research, primarily at TRL 1–3. The successful candidate should be comfortable defining research problems, reviewing literature, identifying research gaps, forming hypotheses, designing experiments, and validating new concepts before they reach production stage.

  • Design experiments and validate research concepts.
  • Work with incomplete, limited, or initially unavailable datasets.
  • Engage regularly with external stakeholders to gather context, refine assumptions, and improve data quality.
  • Provide technical consultation and mentor team members.

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong Data Science / AI / ML fundamentals and Python skills.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and limited data.
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills.

jobs.api_description_text:
Responsibilities
The TikTok Search Engineering Test Team owns the end-to-end quality of TikTok's global search experience—from query understanding, retrieval, and ranking to generative search experiences (LLM Answers and RAG) and search safety. TikTok Search operates across hundreds of markets and languages, connecting billions of users every day with the videos, creators, products, and information they are looking for. Every relevance regression, latency fluctuation, or unsafe result directly impacts user trust and business outcomes.

We are redefining how search quality is built. By leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and intelligent automation, we are reimagining the entire search testing lifecycle—from query set construction and relevance evaluation to ranking diagnostics, LLM-generated answer evaluation, RAG pipeline verification, and search safety red teaming.

Our mission is to build next-generation AI-powered evaluation and testing capabilities that enable TikTok Search to iterate faster, ship smarter, and remain trustworthy at global scale. You will work at the intersection of Search Engineering, Quality Engineering, and Generative AI, helping shape the future of AI-native Search Quality at TikTok.

As a Software Test Engineer (AI) on the Search team, you will:
- Design and deliver AI-powered testing and evaluation solutions for TikTok Search, covering query understanding, retrieval, ranking, generative search (LLM Answers and RAG), personalization, and multimodal and vertical search scenarios such as video, image, e-commerce, user, and creator search.
- Build LLM-based evaluation pipelines for search relevance, answer faithfulness, groundedness, freshness, coverage, diversity, and safety; construct and continuously maintain multilingual, multi-market query sets and golden datasets that reflect real user intent.
- Drive change impact analysis across the search stack—including index, retrieval, ranking models, and prompt and model changes—through AI-assisted diff analysis, offline replay, side-by-side (SBS) evaluation, and interleaving experiments; strengthen release quality gates and pre-launch verification capabilities.
- Partner closely with search engineering, algorithm, product, and content operations teams to identify quality and engineering productivity pain points across the search lifecycle, propose practical AI-powered solutions, and drive them into production.
- Improve engineering productivity for the search organization by building AI agents and tooling for automated test case generation, log-driven bug analysis, root-cause attribution, and self-healing regression suites.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Retrieval, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
- Experience in software quality assurance or software testing, preferably for search, recommendation, ranking, content understanding, or other large-scale data- or algorithm-driven systems.
- Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, debugging, and quality assurance best practices across the software development lifecycle, including offline evaluation, online A/B testing, and production monitoring.
- Familiarity with distributed systems and search and recommendation infrastructure fundamentals (e.g. inverted indexes, vector indexes, retrieval, ranking, embeddings), plus basic knowledge of iOS and/or Android as search entry points.
- Hands-on experience in one or more testing domains, including automation testing, performance and stress testing, algorithm evaluation, or test platform and tool development.
- Strong interest in Generative AI and Large Language Models, with an understanding of common LLM capabilities, evaluation paradigms (e.g. LLM-as-a-Judge, RAG evaluation, and human evaluation), and real-world search applications.

Preferred Qualifications
- Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or C++.
- Hands-on experience evaluating or testing search, recommendation, ranking, or LLM and RAG systems, including relevance labeling, SBS evaluation, NDCG, MRR, and Recall analysis, faithfulness and groundedness measurement, or hallucination detection.
- Experience developing test automation frameworks, evaluation platforms, query set management tools, or engineering productivity tools for search and algorithm teams.
- Hands-on experience with Generative AI–related projects, including LLM application development, AI agent evaluation, model evaluation, AI-assisted testing, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, or building AI testing frameworks.
- Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g. LLMs, AI coding assistants, or AI agents) to improve testing efficiency, automate test case generation, bug analysis, or search quality workflows.
- Experience with multilingual and cross-market quality work, content safety testing, or vertical search domains such as e-commerce, video, or creator search.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

AI / ML Model Development & Deployment

Research & Innovation

  • Stay up to date with the evolving AI landscape and introduce relevant tools, techniques, and best practices to the team.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering or data science roles
  • Demonstrable track record of delivering at least 2–3 ML projects (beyond notebooks — production or near-production) and 1–2 GenAI / agentic AI projects
  • Strong Python programming skills including Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals including feature engineering, model evaluation, bias-variance trade-off, and hyperparameter optimisation
  • Hands-on experience building RAG chatbots and applications using LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent

  • Practical experience with at least one vector database such as Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector, or equivalent
  • Experience with at least one cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP for model training or deployment
  • Proficiency with Git, CI/CD basics, and containerisation (Docker)
  • Ability to read and write at least one additional programming language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, or advanced SQL

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience building voice AI bots using a pro-code approach such as Twilio, Amazon Connect, Deepgram, Whisper + TTS pipelines
  • Exposure to agentic patterns such as tool-calling agents, ReAct loops, multi-step planning, or reflection mechanisms
  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling such as MLflow, Weights & Biases (W&B), model registries, or orchestration tools like Airflow, Prefect, or ZenML
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for RAG and GenAI outputs such as RAGAS, DeepEval, or promptfoo
  • Knowledge of responsible AI principles including bias detection, fairness metrics, and output guardrails
  • Exposure to NLP pipelines including entity extraction, text classification, and summarisation
  • Prior experience in a systems integrator (SI), consultancy, or multi-client delivery environment

Why Join NCS

  • Lead high-impact Data & AI advisory programs for major enterprises and public sector clients.

  • Shape enterprise strategies and governance frameworks that drive real transformation.

  • Work with a talented, multidisciplinary team in a collaborative environment.

  • Competitive compensation and strong professional development support.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

Overview

As an Applied AI Product Engineer, you will build internal products and integrations that help content, product and research teams design, evaluate and launch AI-powered experiences. You will work across the product lifecycle, from understanding ambiguous user problems and defining a technical approach to implementation, launch and iteration.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Most of your time will be spent designing, coding, testing and operating solutions, with enough internal user interaction to make sure the right problems are being solved. A core part of the role is turning repeated technical support and manual workflows into reliable self-service tools. The work spans AI product evaluation tooling, data and analytics workflows, and new applied-AI prototypes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with technical and non-technical users to understand the problem, desired outcome and constraints before selecting a solution
  • Build end-to-end internal products, integrations and data workflows
  • Turn prototypes and one-off solutions into reliable, reusable capabilities
  • Design evaluation and feedback loops for AI-powered workflows
  • Apply production engineering practices, including testing, observability, actionable errors and safe failure handling
  • Use AI coding tools thoughtfully, reviewing and validating all generated work
  • Measure adoption, quality, time saved and reduction in manual support
  • Create documentation and onboarding paths so users and engineers can operate independently
  • Own and prioritise several technical workstreams, making clear trade-offs based on impact and complexity
What a Typical Day Looks Like

jobs.api_description_text:
NUSX Labs is NUSX's technical arm, turning NUS research into inventions, patents, and licensed deals. We're a small, hands-on team, and every AI system we ship is graded against a ground-truth dataset built by hand: for six months, you're the one building it, and your judgments become the benchmark the next model is measured against. It's judgment work, not data entry, across an LLM pipeline that reads patent documents into structured data, a natural-language query layer, and early-signal deal-sourcing tools. You'll be supervised directly by an engineer on the team, with real stakeholder-facing projects and deployment experience.

This is a 6-month internship with the potential for conversion to a full-time position, subject to individual performance and business needs.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Build benchmark datasets used to evaluate model performance, across approximately 23 document types, using Claude and Antigravity to draft and an annotation tool to review and refine
  • Run the blind-test evaluation matrix on vendor deliverables and measure extraction reliability against the ground truth
  • Identify edge cases, structural mismatches, and hallucinations that surface-level review would miss, and document them
  • Review existing system interfaces to determine what each screen stores, and build the gold field and schema catalog
  • Compile findings into quality-acceptance reports used by the team to sign off on deliveries
  • Scope may extend beyond the responsibilities listed above

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience building and shipping a data pipeline (personal, academic, or hackathon) to completion
  • Working knowledge of Python for processing structured data (JSON/CSV)
  • Familiarity with evaluation concepts (precision, recall, accuracy) and LLM evaluation metrics
  • Willingness to learn domain knowledge (e.g. patents)
  • Basic familiarity with version control (git)
  • Willingness to use AI tools (Claude, Antigravity) daily
  • Nice to have: basic SQL; basic cloud experience (GCP/AWS); familiarity with data engineering concepts; comfortable reading and working in English and Chinese

About the Team

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping developers and enterprises safely and effectively deploy OpenAI technologies in production. We act as trusted technical advisors and thought partners for customers, working side by side with their teams to identify high-value use cases, design practical architectures, and move from prototype to durable deployment.

Cybersecurity is one of the most urgent domains where AI can help. Security teams are under pressure to reason across code, logs, infrastructure, tickets, alerts, and vulnerability data faster than ever. As frontier models become more capable, organizations need deep technical guidance on how to evaluate, validate, and safely deploy AI systems in security-critical workflows.

About the Role

We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer, Cyber to partner with customers and help them apply OpenAI models, APIs, Codex, and agentic workflows to real cybersecurity use cases. You will work with CISOs, security executives, application security leaders, SOC teams, security engineering teams, and hands-on practitioners to identify where AI can create measurable security outcomes.

This is a customer-facing technical role for someone who can move fluidly between executive strategy, practitioner-level cyber depth, and hands-on solution design. You will help customers evaluate and deploy workflows such as secure code review, vulnerability triage, threat modeling, remediation, SOC and incident response workflows, detection engineering, cloud security, GRC automation, and security validation.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Research, and Security to turn customer needs into safe deployment patterns, reusable field assets, and product feedback. This role is based in our Singapore office. We offer relocation support to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply embed with strategic customers as the technical lead for AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows, serving as a trusted partner to both security executives and technical practitioners.

jobs.api_description_text:
About Nusx Labs

NUSX Labs is the AI team at NUSX. Behind every NUS invention that reaches the market and every research grant that funds a lab sits a long trail of paperwork. We turn that trail into software people actually use, so research gets out of the lab faster.

Every year, thousands of invention disclosures, patent filings, agreements and grant milestones move through inboxes, spreadsheets and half a dozen systems that were never designed to talk to each other. People re-key the same facts, chase status by hand, and hear about problems late. We are building the layer that connects those systems, with AI doing the clerical reading and sorting on top of it, so the people who move NUS research into the world spend their time on the work that needs a person.

THE ROLE

You will be a hands-on engineer at NUSX Labs. You own connectors and AI-assisted workflows end to end: build them, test them, ship them to real users, and keep them running.

What you'll ship in your first six months:

  • An integration backbone. Every system plugs in the same way: one auth pattern, one schema contract, contract tests, and docs a new teammate can copy
  • An agent harness with deterministic guardrails. A tool server that lets agents and automations write to shared boards, with the limits enforced in code rather than the prompt: allow-listed boards and columns, every write logged, no deletes
  • An intake agent. An inbound email arrives, and a structured, classified ticket comes out the other side, backed by an evaluation set so we know exactly how often it gets it right
  • A milestone watchdog. It reads award milestones from the source systems, spots what is due or at risk before anyone has to chase, and writes a status flag back for the team
  • A demo you can stand behind in front of senior leadership, with the documentation to hand it on

Why you'll like it here

  • You own it end to end. From day one, you build, test, ship and run each connector or workflow yourself
  • Your work ships. It goes to real users, not an internal tool, not a shiny demo
  • Close to users. You run requirements and acceptance testing directly with the people who use the result, and you change the work based on what you learn
  • Close to the decisions. You work directly with the technical lead and present your work to senior leadership
  • AI-native by default. Claude Code or an equivalent is part of every working day, and we expect you to be fast and surgical with it

Requirements

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, data engineering, system integration or automation development. An AI-specific job title is not required
  • Strong Python or TypeScript/Node, with experience building and consuming REST and/or GraphQL APIs, authentication (OAuth, service accounts) and SQL/Postgres
  • You have shipped at least one feature, integration or workflow that calls an LLM API. Classification, extraction, agents and RAG all count, and no particular framework is expected
  • Good testing habits, including integration or contract testing, and documentation another person can follow
  • Daily use of AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar)
  • Comfort working with non-technical users and turning a vague pain point into working software
  • Degree or diploma in a technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Familiar with writing MCP servers from scratch or other tool-calling backends
  • Familiar with one or more of: Monday.com (GraphQL), n8n, Google Workspace or Slack integrations
  • Familiar with agentic skill writing, optimisation
  • Evaluation sets or prompt regression checks for LLM features
  • Embeddings, vector databases (pgvector or similar) and RAG
  • Experience with Google Cloud
  • Comfortable reading and working in English and Chinese

Please be informed that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

More Information

Job Type: 2-Year Contract

Location: Kent Ridge Campus

Organisation: NUSX

Department: Administration

Role Overview

We are looking for a versatile and commercially minded Full-Stack AI Engineer to drive artificial intelligence transformation across our diverse parent company portfolio. Our subsidiaries span printing & packaging, regulated communications, security, IT consulting, and language translation. Because of this multi-domain footprint, you will have a rich, continuous pipeline of unique business challenges to solve.

This role requires a true hybrid professional: part business analyst, part full-stack developer, and part AI integration specialist. You will not be siloed into just writing code or training models. Instead, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle—speaking directly with stakeholders to gather requirements, rapidly building Proof of Concepts (POCs) to validate ideas, engineering robust AI solutions, and deploying them to production on AWS. If you thrive on autonomy, enjoy full-stack development, and want to see your AI solutions generate tangible operational value across completely different industries, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End AI Product Ownership & Solutioning

  • Act as the technical and business bridge: consult directly with internal stakeholders across our various subsidiaries to understand their workflows, pain points, and operational bottlenecks.

  • Gather requirements, conduct feasibility research, and architect pragmatic AI/automation solutions.

  • Rapidly prototype and demo Proof of Concepts (POCs) to refine product vision before committing to full-scale development.

  • Take successful POCs from local prototypes to fully productionized, scalable applications deployed in AWS.

AI Agent & LLM Development

  • Design and build intelligent agents and multi-step workflows using the Claude Agent SDK and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, integrating structured and unstructured data from diverse subsidiaries.

  • Implement function/tool calling, prompt engineering, context management, and decision logic to automate complex business processes.

Classical Machine Learning

  • Select, build, and evaluate classical ML models (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection) using scikit-learn where a lightweight, interpretable, or cost-efficient model is a better fit than an LLM.

  • Prepare and engineer features from structured business data, and validate models using appropriate metrics and cross-validation.

  • Combine classical ML models with LLM-based workflows (e.g., as routers, classifiers, scorers, or confidence estimators) to improve accuracy, latency, and cost.

Full-Stack Engineering & Deployment

  • Develop intuitive, responsive user interfaces and internal dashboards using Next.js.

  • Build scalable, high-performance backend services and REST APIs using FastAPI (Python).

  • Containerize applications and manage cloud-native deployments on AWS (e.g., ECS, EKS, Lambda, or EC2).

  • Establish CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth, automated testing and delivery of software.

LLMOps, Observability & Quality Assurance

  • Implement robust tracking, evaluation, and cost-monitoring for LLM calls using Langfuse.

  • Ensure AI solutions are reliable, secure, and grounded, establishing confidence thresholds for autonomous agent actions.

  • Establish evaluation and monitoring frameworks covering accuracy, hallucination, retrieval quality, task completion, latency, cost, and business outcomes.

The Tech Stack

  • Observability & LLMOps: Langfuse, Prometheus, Grafana

  • Education: Formal qualifications in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Computer Engineering—OR equivalent practical, demonstrated work experience

  • AI Fluency: Practical, hands-on experience building applied LLM applications, agentic workflows, and RAG systems (this is an applied role, not model training/research)

  • Classical ML Experience: Hands-on experience with classical machine learning models using scikit-learn (e.g., logistic regression, tree-based and ensemble methods, clustering), including feature engineering, model evaluation, and deploying models as part of production services

  • Consultative Communication: Strong business acumen and excellent communication skills. You must be comfortable leading requirements-gathering sessions with non-technical business leaders and translating their needs into technical architecture

The Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team plays a critical role in conducting close-loop data-driven business iterations. As business intelligence specialists and data analysts, our scope of work is not limited to just performance monitoring and reporting, but also in proactively finding actionable insights to help drive high-impact business changes. Our end-to-end data solution reduces the gap between the business teams and technical teams, and achieves real ‘intelligence’ in the iteration cycle. Browse our Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.

About the Team:

This role is embedded within the Data Analyst team under the Buyer & Marketing Product Line, working alongside analysts who own business metrics and stakeholder relationships. The team leverages data and AI technologies to improve analytical productivity and support business decision-making at scale, building reusable analytics solutions, automating recurring workflows, and enabling faster, more consistent insights across multiple markets. The role sits at the intersection of data analytics, business decision support, and Applied AI — centering on helping analysts and business teams scale analytical workflows through AI-powered automation, reusable data agents, Text-to-SQL systems, and internal productivity tools. Interns will have access to modern AI development tools, including Claude with dedicated usage credits.

Job Description:

  • Partner with product managers and business stakeholders to understand business objectives, metric definitions, analytical requirements, and decision-making processes
  • Identify recurring analytical tasks and business workflows that can be standardised or automated through AI-powered solutions
  • Translate business knowledge — metric definitions, table relationships, calculation logic, and filtering rules — into reusable agent skills, structured runbooks, and automated workflows
  • Support metric monitoring and anomaly detection workflows, connecting business risk signals with agent validation logic
  • Build and improve LLM-powered analytics workflows for use cases such as Text-to-SQL, A/B testing analysis, and multi-region analytics
  • Collaborate with regional stakeholders to understand market-specific business logic, reporting requirements, and metric definitions
  • Use SQL, Python, Claude Code, and related AI development tools to build internal productivity tools, skill generators, SQL validators, and evaluation utilities
  • Design test cases and validation frameworks to evaluate agent accuracy, consistency, and failure-handling behaviour.
  • Investigate failure modes such as schema-linking errors, missing filters, incorrect denominators, empty results, and malformed structured outputs, and improve validation mechanisms accordingly
  • Analyse workflow execution logs and traces to improve observability, maintainability, and system reliability
  • Document best practices, workflows, and user guides to support adoption across teams and regions

Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions, and general data warehouse concepts
  • Working knowledge of Python for automation, scripting, or data processing
  • Basic understanding of A/B testing, experimentation methodologies, and statistical significance
  • Interest in understanding how e-commerce metrics connect to business decisions and willingness to learn domain-specific analytical workflows
  • Strong interest in LLM applications, AI agents, workflow automation, or developer productivity tools
  • Ability to understand business problems, translate them into analytical questions, and design practical solutions
  • Comfortable working with cross-functional stakeholders, including analysts, product managers, engineers, and business teams
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills
  • Comfortable using AI coding tools such as Claude Code while reviewing, validating, and maintaining generated outputs

About the Team

The Applied AI Architect team partners with organisations to turn OpenAI’s most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

About the Role

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for a portfolio of OpenAI customers. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will prioritise customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth.

You will remain accountable for the team’s technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching.

This role is based in Singapore.

In this role, you will:

  • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, building experienced architects’ autonomy, leadership, and architectural judgement while maintaining high standards of accountability, continuous learning, and customer stewardship.

  • Independently define and refine your team’s strategy, priorities, and operating model, aligning company priorities, customer needs, and the Singapore go-to-market while balancing near-term execution with long-term team capability.

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritise accounts and opportunities, make complex resource-allocation decisions, and establish clear technical strategies for your team’s portfolio.

  • Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production.

  • Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.

  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed.

  • Mobilise Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

  • Remain accountable for the team’s technical progress and customer outcomes, while agreeing clear owners, milestones and handoffs with Deployment, Implementation and Enablement teams for the work they execute.

  • Establish a rigorous view of portfolio health, including technical wins, qualified use cases, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, measurable customer impact, and the technical contribution to growth.

  • Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Research, and go-to-market teams, while developing reusable architecture guidance and customer practices.

  • Build a culture that balances ambitious customer outcomes with responsible AI deployment, clear ownership, thoughtful prioritisation, and effective specialist handoffs.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Possess deep technical acumen in modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, platform technologies, software and cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, identity, security, privacy, evaluation, and enterprise deployment.

  • Bring 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting, including work with large and complex enterprises.

  • Have 4+ years of people-management experience hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing technical teams.

  • Have guided enterprise organisations from technical discovery and evaluation through production adoption, healthy usage, and measurable business impact.

  • Demonstrate outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, boards, business leaders, and hands-on engineers.

  • Can lead a complex portfolio, make thoughtful resource-allocation decisions, and balance regional strategy with hands-on support for critical customer engagements.

  • Exercise strong architectural judgement, including knowing when to go deep personally, when to coach the team, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.

  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Deployment, Customer Engagement, Security, Legal, Privacy, and external partner ecosystems.

  • Embody a customer-centric philosophy focused on durable value, responsible production adoption, technical excellence, and long-term partnership.

  • Approach your work with humility, curiosity, a collaborative spirit, and a deep commitment to the safe and beneficial advancement of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

This is a ground-floor opportunity for the Director of Customer Success to build and own Customer Success across the company's international markets (global with the exception of US), working directly with the CEO as part of the Leadership team. You will define the strategy, processes and team from scratch, adapting the proven playbook already established by the US business for international markets, while also pioneering a new "forward-deployed" model that embeds Customer Success and Engineering directly with customers on the ground, in true applied-AI fashion.


As Director of Customer Success will be the linchpin of the company's international growth outside of the US: strategic enough to shape direction from the leadership table, and hands-on enough to deliver personally in-market across Hong Kong, Thailand and Taiwan, alongside a growing UK presence.

  • Convert the company's existing pilot programmes into full-time, fully deployed customer engagements
  • Build out and ramp local deployment teams across each international geography as new customers come online
  • Design and roll out the forward-deployed Customer Success and Engineering model internationally, working closely with Product and Engineering

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive customer success strategy with the executive team, and the customer success and commercial leadership teams
  • Establish and oversee customer onboarding, adoption, and retention programs across international markets
  • Found and lead the international Customer Success team, including forward deployment, account management and field service
  • Establish, own and track key success metrics (NRR, CSAT, Churn Rate, etc.)
  • Act as the key voice of the customer in product development and internal executive discussions
  • Develop processes for proactive issue resolution and escalations with other Customer Success leaders
  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Engineering to enhance customer outcomes as the AI product evolves
  • Own the execution of quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and strategic customer engagement initiatives


What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in top-tier customer success, consulting, strategy, business development, or corporate leadership roles
  • Experience in a Customer Success role in SaaS, applied AI, or deep tech within a start-up or scale-up.
  • A proven track record of building or scaling a customer success function from the ground up: standing up onboarding, playbooks, tooling and metrics, and operating hands-on as a player-coach before a full team is in place
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead and grow teams through rapid change

  • Ability to analyse data and use insights to drive strategy
  • Prior experience in applied AI, deep tech, or other fast-growing technology businesses is preferred, but not required — no prior experience in this specific industry is necessary
  • Willingness to travel extensively and internationally across the company's active and expansion markets, principally in Asia
